pages.text: Aluminum is the light metal of the first drone frames. You cannot smelt it straight from its ore: just as in real life, it takes electrolysis and a steady flow of power.$(br)$(li)$(item)Bauxite Ore$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Raw Bauxite$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Alumina$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Aluminum Ingot$()

$(li)$(l)Mine Bauxite Ore.$() It shows as rusty clumps in stone and deepslate. It drops $(l)Raw Bauxite$(), and Fortune helps.$(br)$(li)$(l)Smelt or blast$() the Raw Bauxite (or the ore itself) into $(l)Alumina$(), a white powder.
pages.title: From ore to ingot

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Put the Alumina in an$() $(l:materials/electrolyzer)Electrolyzer$(/l)$(l).$() It makes 1 Aluminum Ingot every 5 seconds at 80 FE/t. Two $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generators$(/l) keep it running.
$(li)$(l)Found in$(): Stone and deepslate$(br)$(li)$(l)Heights$(): y -32 to y 80$(br)$(li)$(l)Most common$(): Around y 24$(br)$(li)$(l)How common$(): Almost as common as iron
pages.title: Where to find bauxite

pages.text: Aluminum from other mods works in every CyberFarm recipe, and their crushers and furnaces can process our ore. The tags are:$(br)$(li)$(l)Aluminum Ingot$(): forge:ingots/aluminum$(br)$(li)$(l)Alumina$(): forge:dusts/alumina$(br)$(li)$(l)Bauxite Ore$(): forge:ores/bauxite, forge:ores/aluminum
pages.title: Other mods

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Raw Bauxite$(): forge:raw_materials/aluminum, forge:raw_materials/bauxite$(br)Already have an aluminum ore from another mod? Set bauxiteGeneration = false under [world] in cyberfarm-common.toml, and only theirs generates (in new chunks only).
